title: Pan-Seared Australian Skillet Steak
description: A simple recipe for a flavorful and tender skillet steak, inspired by Australian cuisine. This dish is best served with a side of sautéed mushrooms and crispy vegetables.
instructions: Season the steak with salt and pepper.
Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the steak for 3-4 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 130°F.
Remove the steak from the skillet and let it rest.
Sauté the mushrooms and potatoes in the skillet until they are tender.
Serve the steak with the sautéed mushrooms and potatoes.
